name: Clockspinning
oracle_text:
Buyback {3} (You may pay an additional {3} as you cast this spell. If you do, put this card into your hand as it resolves.)
Choose a counter on target permanent or suspended card. Remove that counter from that permanent or card or put another of those counters on it.
blocked_sentences: Choose a counter on target permanent or suspended card. Remove that counter from that permanent or card or put another of those counters on it.

needs.what: an op (or an `as` binding on a counter-kind choice) that has the controller choose one kind of counter already on the target and binds it, so a following `choose_mode` can either remove one counter of that kind or put one more of that same kind on it -- add_counters reading `counter: {"binding": <as>}` from an effect-made choice rather than from a counter_placed trigger
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_counters needs a printed kind; its `{"binding": "counter"}` form is allowed only on a counter_placed trigger (`_counter_kind` reads the trigger's event binding). remove_counters with any_kind can remove a chosen kind but binds nothing usable to add the same kind, and proliferate touches every permanent and player rather than the one target

needs.what: a target spec that may pick either a permanent on the battlefield or a suspended card in exile (702.62b: exiled, has suspend, has a time counter -- the engine's `suspended_by` mark), and removing the last time counter from a suspended card this way must trigger suspend's free cast (702.62a), not only the upkeep tick
needs.why_existing_wont_do: selector_keys has no suspended key and a target spec has one kind/zone; `zone: exile` + `has_counters: "time"` is only an approximation, and suspend.tick alone casts the card when the last counter comes off, so an effect removal would strand it in exile
